verdict.rationale: Runloop documents an MCP Hub that gives agents running in its Devboxes access to MCP tool servers without exposing credentials. That is a dedicated way to plug MCP servers in, but Runloop brokers them to hosted agents rather than consuming the tools itself, and the evidence is only a one-line page description. Missing for 10: details on how MCP servers are registered or configured, which transports and servers are supported, how tools reach agents in practice, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
